capabilities: group tabs into named, colored, collapsible groups
drag whole groups within tab bars and move a group to a new window
fuzzy-search all open tabs and jump to one
open tabs in new split views (up to 3 columns) and duplicate or pin tabs
run tab operations as commands with user-assigned hotkeys
extras: Interface is in Chinese; desktop only. Group membership is stored per tab id in data.json and restored after restart.
problem: Obsidian's tab strip has no grouping, so users with many open tabs cannot organize, color, collapse, or move tabs as units.
summary: Chrome-style tab grouping for Obsidian desktop: name, color, collapse and drag tab groups, plus tab search and extra tab commands.
